<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>emitThumbRegPlusImmInReg - Emits a series of instructions to materialize a destreg = basereg + immediate in Thumb code.</p>


<p>Materialize the immediate in a register using mov / mvn (armv6-M &gt;) sequences, movs / lsls / adds / lsls / adds / lsls / adds sequences (armv6-M) or load the immediate from a constpool entry.</p>
